correctness.rationale: The complete normalized real octonary Walsh–Haar basis has one constant and seven contrasts per internal node. For fixed row (recentered at the all-zero leaf by XOR), only ancestral signs contribute. With local h_y=Σ_{a≠0}σ_a(-1)^{a·y} over 128 signed contrast profiles, exact row decomposition gives F_d(t)=max_sigma[(Σ_{y≠0}|t+h_y|)/8+F_{d-1}((t+h_0)/8)], F_0(t)=|t|. Independent 128-sign enumeration yields ten distinct sorted Walsh profiles. For |t|<=1, successors stay in this invariant window and every local |t+h_y| is affine. The alleged maximizing profile (h0,S,Z)=(1,17,1) dominates all ten actions for B∈[1/7,1],t∈[0,1] by 40 exact corner inequalities on bilinear differences; it is attained by a real sign vector. The resulting A_d+B_d|t| recursion solves to U8(d)=15d/7+13/49+36/(49·8^d). The binary Haar recurrence gives U2(n)=2n/3+5/9+(4/9)(-1/2)^n. Substituting n=3d shows equality d=0,1,2 and strict octonary excess for every d>=3, via elementary closed-form difference. Finite Bellman checks d<=4 corroborate, not substitute for the invariant affine-window induction.
